csv_project_name: DB For Bowling Center & F&B Upgrades
csv_agency: US Department of the Navy - Facilities Branch
csv_scope_of_work: The project includes all design and construction necessary to renovate and modernize the eight (8) lane Bowling Center (Bldg. 485) to include replacement of the existing pinsetter unit with new pinsetter unit to include string bowling, electronic gaming area and food operation including all demolition, installation, renovation, temporary construction and restoration necessary to produce a complete and useable facility.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: Design-Build for Bowling Center and Food & Beverage Upgrades
short_description: Design-build renovation and modernization of an eight-lane bowling center in El Centro.
project_scope: Renovation and modernization of Bowling Center Building 485, including replacement of the existing pinsetter system with a new string-bowling pinsetter unit, creation of an electronic gaming area, and upgrades to food service operations. Scope includes all required demolition, installation, renovation, temporary construction, and restoration to deliver a complete usable facility. Existing facility has 8 bowling lanes.
services: Design-build services including architecture, rehabilitation/refurbishment, civil engineering, landscape architecture, inspection services, and electrical, fire protection, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Small building renovation project with limited structural ambition.
- Primarily an interior modernization of a bowling center and food service area.
- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or complex structural system indicated.
- Includes design-build and civil engineering components, but structural engineering relevance for sbp appears low.
- Building type is not among sbp's priority sectors such as cultural, university, or major public landmark buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost stated as $2.3M.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee stated in the source. Only total construction cost of $2.3M is provided.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include architecture, design-build/developer, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, inspection services, and electrical, fire protection, and mechanical engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
